abi_decision.reason: The existing GDN and MLP handles each privately own their Metal device, command queue, buffers, command-buffer creation, commit, and wait. Calling their public Rust APIs would necessarily create at least two command buffers and two waits.
abi_decision.minimal_refactor: Expose existing packed GDN fields at crate scope, keep the public packed ABI unchanged, concatenate the existing GDN and MLP Metal kernel sources at build time, and construct one independent combined handle from those packed arrays.
